# Zero Lines

> Zero Lines is a clinical-luxury Skin Longevity House with houses in Gibraltar, Andorra and Marbella, and a laboratory in Barcelona. Six bioactive formulations — built on hydrolysed collagen, botanical peptides and Pyrenean mineral water — are used in a fixed order called the Zero Lines Longevity Protocol. Every formulation is designed for two effects at once: an immediate one, visible from the first application, and a lasting one that builds with consistent use.

Key facts:

- The core idea: skin knows how to repair itself; time, stress and environment quieten that instruction. The house line is "We restore the signal" — Zero Lines does not fight your biology, it activates it.
- Every formulation pairs an immediate effect (the skin looks visibly smoother the same day) with a lasting effect (consistent use supports the skin's own structure, so lines have less to return to).
- Zero Lines is a cosmetics house, not a medical brand. It describes appearance only and publishes no clinical statistics.
- The mineral water comes from a protected valley in the Andorran Pyrenees, at just over 1,800 metres — no agriculture, no industry and no permanent settlement within five kilometres of the spring.
- Formulations are developed in the company's own laboratory in Poblenou, Barcelona. The flagship is in Gibraltar, with houses in Andorra la Vella and Marbella.
- Products are not yet available to purchase. The site takes waitlist registrations for early access ahead of launch.
- The testimonials page is deliberately held open until launch: the house publishes no customer voices before it has customers.
- The two effects are named, throughout, the immediate effect and the lasting effect. No other name is used for them.
- Actives are named on every formulation page. Full INCI lists are published when the formulations go on sale.
- Site language is British English (analyser, hydrolysed).

## The Protocol

Six steps, one fixed order. Full sequence: https://zerolines.life/protocol/

1. [Renew — Bio-Renewal Peeling Gel](https://zerolines.life/products/peeling-gel/): weekly exfoliation that clears the way for everything that follows.
2. [Activate — Precision Collagen Renewal Line Corrector](https://zerolines.life/products/line-corrector/): precise application to expression lines; the skin looks visibly smoother within minutes and holds through the day.
3. [Signal — Bio-Signal Face Serum](https://zerolines.life/products/serum/): the daily treatment step, carrying the collagen–peptide–mineral complex.
4. [Shield — Environmental Shield Day Cream](https://zerolines.life/products/day-cream/): morning protection against environmental stress.
5. [Restore — Renewal and Repair Night Cream](https://zerolines.life/products/night-cream/): evening repair while the skin does its overnight work.
6. [Sustain — Precision Collagen Renewal Refill](https://zerolines.life/products/line-corrector-refill/): the same formulation as the Line Corrector, in a cartridge that replaces the spent one in the applicator you already have. At weekly use, roughly one a year.

## Skin Analyser

- [Skin Analyser](https://zerolines.life/analyser/): sixteen questions and one photograph; reads texture, tone, hydration, pores, pigmentation, lines, elasticity and sun exposure, then returns a written assessment and the protocol that follows from it.
- It is free, needs no account and no payment, and is available now rather than at launch. An email address is required: the assessment is written out and sent there, and does not appear on the page. The email carries a private link to reopen it and save it as a PDF, valid for thirty days.
- The photograph is read once by the analysis service the house contracts, is not stored, is never attached to a name, and is not sent in the email.
- It does not diagnose, does not remember you between visits, and does not track change over time.
